expectations.text: Rejects 'the decoder is too slow' as the root cause and identifies that nothing is ever released as why memory only climbs
expectations.evidence: rejects decoder-too-slow; retention/lifetime bug -> memory staircases

expectations.text: Explains that lazy-loading images without releasing off-screen rows still leaks, because every row stays in render()'s output and keeps its views/textures
expectations.evidence: lazy-in without release-out still grows; row node never leaves tree so LRU cannot reclaim

expectations.text: Fix virtualizes the list: only rows near the viewport are realized; rows leaving the window have their nodes/textures released so memory plateaus
expectations.evidence: view/image windows from scrollY (visible +/-1); off-window rows data-only, textures free

expectations.text: Distinguishes the full catalog as data from the small realized window of views+textures
expectations.evidence: data vs realized window distinguished explicitly

expectations.text: Recommends recycling a fixed pool of row/tile views rather than creating and destroying nodes on every scroll step
expectations.evidence: fixed pool of ~5 row nodes rebound by field-writes, no per-step alloc
